races.paceDynamic: Vincenzo Peruggia and Utmost Good Faith will clash from the off, with both confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead over this testing 1m at Musselburgh. Their dual ensures an honest gallop from the start, with the pace maintained throughout as neither will want to concede the initiative. The remaining four runners all prefer to settle behind, meaning the leaders will get an uncontested run once the initial duel is resolved. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will stretch the field and create opportunities for closers to pick off tired leaders in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between the two leaders is fierce and unsustainable
scenarios.body: The leaders will weaken in the final quarter-mile as Vincenzo Peruggia and Utmost Good Faith pay for their early exertions. The hold-up horses with fresh finishing kicks will sweep past the tiring pace-setters in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gains a clear advantage early and the other folds
scenarios.body: The surviving front runner gets an easier lead once their rival drops away, allowing them to control the pace and kick clear. Utmost Good Faith's recent form edge gives him the better chance of outlasting Vincenzo Peruggia.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with both leaders going too fast too early
scenarios.body: Monoceros can track the early pace without getting involved in the battle, then strike when the leaders falter. His prominent style allows him to avoid the carnage while staying close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Rally Falls Short
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get too far back on the testing ground
scenarios.body: The soft going makes it harder for the closers to make up significant ground in the straight. One of the pace-setters hangs on grimly despite the honest gallop throughout.

races.paceDynamic: Goldmoyne will lead this from the outset but faces immediate pressure from five prominent runners (Midnight Gun, Golden Mind, Al Arbeed, Royal Zabeel, A War Eagle) all wanting forward positions in a small 10-runner field. The pace will be genuine as these horses jostle for position through the early stages, with particular congestion likely 2-3 furlongs out when the prominent brigade try to kick. Only two true hold-up horses (Persuasion, Jannas Journey) will benefit from the inevitable pace collapse. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine early pace and prominent congestion will stretch the field and create opportunities for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard early chasing Goldmoyne
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will string out the field and leave the front-runners vulnerable to late challengers. Persuasion and Jannas Journey can pick off tired leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Goldmoyne leads throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Goldmoyne gets an easy lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The 6-year-old's excellent recent form (four wins in five starts) allows him to dictate terms and kick clear when it matters. His low TopSpeed rating of 53 suggests he's more effective when controlling the tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent battle succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If one of the forward horses can secure the perfect pitch behind Goldmoyne
scenarios.body: Golden Mind or Midnight Gun can use their class advantage to strike from the ideal tracking position. The winner emerges from the prominent pack that avoids the early scrimmaging.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is even stronger than expected with multiple horses going forward
scenarios.body: Complete pace meltdown allows a closer to come from further back than usual. The entire prominent pack ties up simultaneously in the final two furlongs.

races.paceDynamic: Roaring Legend will dictate terms from the front with no obvious pressure, likely setting a steady tempo over this extended trip on testing ground. The prominent runners Al Qareem and Lady Vivian may track within striking distance, but with three hold-up horses (Mount Atlas, Kate O'Riley, Many Men) positioned to pounce late, the early gallop should be manageable. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the uncontested pace will leave plenty in reserve for those who can unleash late kicks, particularly on ground that rewards stamina over pure speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is modest and the hold-up trio get their favoured strong finish.
scenarios.body: Mount Atlas and Many Men benefit most from Oisin Murphy and Pat Cosgrave's patient rides, sweeping past tiring leaders in the final two furlongs. The extended distance and soft ground play perfectly into their stamina-laden profiles.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: Al Qareem's class edge (OR 114) tells under Clifford Lee's positive ride, while Lady Vivian could spring a surprise given her two wins from good positions earlier this year. Both avoid the traffic issues that may plague the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Roaring Legend sets a conservative tempo and finds extra reserves when challenged.
scenarios.body: Jason Hart capitalises on the uncontested lead, gradually winding up the pace from the three-furlong pole to stretch the field. Roaring Legend's recent consistent efforts suggest he can sustain his kick despite carrying the early burden.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Kate O'Riley Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the lowest-weighted runner gets a dream run.
scenarios.body: Kate O'Riley benefits from her 123lbs burden and Cieren Fallon's opportunistic riding, finding gaps as higher-rated rivals tire on the testing surface. Her recent second over similar conditions at this trip suggests untapped potential.

races.paceDynamic: Almuhit will lead from the gate with no sustained pressure, as the next-closest pace horses Gambino, Sportingsilvermine and Baileys Khelstar prefer to sit just off the pace rather than challenge early. This creates a controlled tempo through the middle sections, allowing the large contingent of hold-up horses to be nursed along before the real racing begins. The combination of soft ground conditions and the sustainable early pace will see the field bunched turning for home, creating a sprint finish over the final 3-4 furlongs. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — they get the ideal scenario of a steady pace followed by a cavalry charge finish that suits their closing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Almuhit maintains an uncontested lead through halfway, creating the perfect stalking scenario
scenarios.body: The soft ground amplifies stamina demands in the closing stages, perfectly suiting the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade. Horses like Moon Over Miami, Wise Eagle and Team Player can time their runs to perfection in what becomes a pure staying test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Gambino or Sportingsilvermine apply early pressure to Almuhit, creating a more genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses positioned handy who can kick when others are feeling the pinch. Gambino's recent winning form and Sportingsilvermine's proven soft ground ability become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Almuhit gets completely uncontested fractions and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage on the testing ground, with the chasing pack's finishing kicks blunted by the conditions. Almuhit's stamina reserves and Sean Levey's tactical ride prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian with multiple horses still in contention at the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race develops into a messy sprint finish where positioning and a clear run matter more than running style. The highest-rated horses with tactical speed can capitalise on the bunched finish.

races.paceDynamic: Democracy Dilemma will face no pressure on the lead with just one other confirmed front runner in this field. Six horses want prominent positions (Pilgrim, Rhythm N Hooves, Tropical Storm, Eternal Sunshine, Heavenly Heather, Lexington Blitz, Archduke Ferdinand, Against The Wind, Canon's House, Gangsta Man) creating significant congestion behind the leader. This packed prominent group will create traffic problems turning for home on Musselburgh's tight track, with several horses getting shuffled back. This setup strongly favours the leader Democracy Dilemma and the two hold-up horses (Jer Batt, Vintage Clarets) who can avoid the early scramble and find clear runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma gets an easy lead without pressure from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The Cowell-trained leader can dictate fractions and kick clear when the packed field behind gets into traffic trouble. His recent third places show he's hitting form and Rossa Ryan's booking suggests stable confidence.

scenarios.trigger: If the ten prominent runners create a cavalry charge that sets up the race for closers

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Cowell Treble Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Rhythm N Hooves finds the gap that others miss in the prominent pack scramble
scenarios.body: Robert Cowell's 1/5 recent record and Jason Hart's tactical nous sees this one thread through traffic when others get stopped. Recent fourth at this trip shows he's ready to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Balding Raider Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Tropical Storm's 203-day break has him primed and Oisin Murphy finds a dream run
scenarios.body: Andrew Balding's 8/29 strike rate this fortnight and Murphy's booking despite the long layoff suggests something is expected. The winner's form from last year makes him dangerous fresh.

The large contingent of hold-up horses including Wheels Of Fire, Montezuma, Zarzyni, Arnhem, Water Of Leith, Classy Al and Woohoo will get their preferred strong pace to aim at.
